deprecated_cmx.description: Setting up Meraki presence detection with the CMX location service in YAML is deprecated and will stop working. Remove the `meraki` platform from the `device_tracker` section of your `configuration.yaml` file, restart Home Assistant, and add the Meraki integration in the UI with a Meraki Dashboard API key instead. It tracks whether Wi-Fi and wired clients are connected, without their position on the map. Bluetooth devices are not tracked yet.
